summary: Completed testing of WanderMark sort/filter and Travel Diaries features. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Sort buttons work, tab navigation works but has React Native Web FlatList numColumns limitation causing error when switching between photos (numColumns=2) and diaries (numColumns=1) tabs.

ui_bugs.issue: FlatList numColumns switching error when toggling between Photos (numColumns=2) and Travel Diaries (numColumns=1) tabs. React Native Web's FlatList does not support changing numColumns on the fly even with different key props.
ui_bugs.workaround: User can dismiss the error modal and continue using the app. A proper fix requires using the same numColumns for both lists or implementing a custom grid layout instead of FlatList with numColumns.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: React Native Web's FlatList implementation does not support changing numColumns dynamically, even with different key props. The photos FlatList uses numColumns=2 while diaries FlatList uses numColumns=1 (no columns). When React reconciles the components on tab switch, it throws an invariant violation.
reproduction_steps: 4. Error modal appears: 'Changing numColumns on the fly is not supported'
5. Dismiss error, switch back to Photos tab
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Use conditional rendering with Views wrapping each FlatList (already attempted), but the root issue is in react-native-web's FlatList. Proper fix requires: 1) Using same numColumns for both, or 2) Custom grid implementation using ScrollView + flexWrap, or 3) Separate route/screen for each tab instead of in-component tab switching.
